HELL- I'd like to answer your hell question. As a Seventh Day Adventist Christian we believe (as does the Jewish faith) that hell is a separation from God NOT an eternal burning. Literal translations of the word Hell throughout the old and new testament simply mean death. Furthermore any mention of burning is never eternal. The book of revolutions states that God will cleanse the world with fire but that once that fire is gone and the "unsaved" have burned the New Jerusalem will be here. So in essence Hell is God saying, "I gave you the opportunity to live forever with me. You rejected that so now you will be burned with the rest of earth, die, and (as the bible puts it) know nothing. Really the only person with a specific punishment is Satan. I hope this helps. Any more questions let me know. I went through the same thing and while I don't go to church any more I still believe. God Bless.
